t: That this Act may be cited as the “Maritime Education and Training Act of 1980”.

fable.w: This section only provides the short title of the Act ("Maritime Education and Training Act of 1980"). The words "Education and Training" might suggest outside stakeholders such as maritime academies or states, but they appear only in a proper noun. The section sets up no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government.
